Either a stored artifact or an explicit reason it is
A phone that receives push notifications (ADR-014). The
token is Firebase Cloud Messaging's address for one install
of the app. It is removed when the user signs out, when FCM
says it is no longer valid, and with the account.
One row per client operation. idempotency_key makes retries
Append-only (UPDATE/DELETE blocked by trigger). Each row
stores the previous row's hash; seq, prev_hash and row_hash
are assigned by a BEFORE INSERT trigger.
